evidence.testName: the fixture passes registry rows through the real board model

evidence.testName: the fixture cells carry real provenance including vendor and source timestamp

results.note: mixedBoard.ts:13-15 throws at module top-level (module boundary) when !import.meta.env.DEV; test at mixedBoard.test.ts:123-132 stubs DEV=false, resets modules, and asserts the dynamic import rejects with the guard's message.
